core_idea: Social life is made of fields, arenas where people compete for different forms of capital: economic, cultural, social and symbolic. Habitus, durable dispositions acquired through upbringing, shapes tastes and choices so that inequality tends to reproduce itself.

common_mistakes: Using only one concept (e.g. cultural capital) without field and habitus.
Measuring cultural capital as 'highbrow' participation only.
